create.name: Astrid Blankenburg
create.bio:
Astrid Blankenburg, who teaches under the name Astrid the Psychic Witch, is a tarot reader and esoteric teacher and the co-founder of the School of Holistic Mastery, also called the Magick & Witchcraft Academy. Before moving her teaching online she ran in-person classes on esoteric subjects in London, and she has hosted a radio show. The school has offered recorded video courses since 2015 and says more than 24,000 students have completed one.

Her courses are aimed at beginners and are self-paced, with lifetime access and a completion certificate. She covers the groundwork of a personal witchcraft practice, including spell structure, moon phases, correspondences and keeping a Book of Shadows, without tying it to any single tradition. Other courses teach intuitive tarot over twenty daily lessons, the first steps of psychic development and clairvoyance, how to perceive and interpret the aura, and the magical uses of herbs in green witchcraft. Students can also join an optional online community where live rituals and group gatherings are held.

courses.title: Witchcraft Foundation Course
courses.description: A self-paced video course on the basics of a witchcraft practice: how a spell is built, intention, correspondences, moon phases and the Book of Shadows. It follows no single tradition.

courses.title: The 20-Day Intuitive Tarot Masterclass
courses.description: Twenty daily lessons on reading tarot by intuition, starting from choosing and caring for a deck and building towards full readings.

courses.title: Psychic Development for Beginners
courses.description: An introductory course on recognising and training intuitive and psychic senses, with practical exercises for each stage.

courses.title: Aura Analysis & Reading Training
courses.description: Recorded lessons on perceiving the aura and interpreting its colours and qualities, with printable analysis sheets for practising on friends or clients.

courses.title: Green Witchcraft: Working with Magical Herbs
courses.description: A course on the place of herbs in spellwork: the commonly used magical herbs, simple forms of herbal spells, and growing or sourcing herbs for a witch's kit.

free_resources.title: Astrid Blankenburg on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her teacher page on the free Insight Timer app, where she shares recorded guided meditations.
